facts.text: Opened as Madrone Lounge in 2004; Michael Krouse took over in 2008 and renamed it Madrone Art Bar.
The building dates to 1888, designed by Samuel Newsom, and housed Green's Pharmacy for decades.

name: Maggie McGarrys
note: Infatuation places it in North Beach, at 1353 Grant Ave.

facts.text: An Irish pub with live bands most nights and karaoke on Wednesdays.
Magnolia Brewing opened here in 1997, founded by Dave McLean in a former corner pharmacy at Haight and Masonic.
Reopened in December 2024 under local owners Kevin Kynoch, Brian Reccow and Brandon Phillips.
Owned by Martin Rapalski, who also owns the Latin American Club across 22nd Street.
A narrow club with red Naugahyde booths and disco balls, used as a music venue and dance hall.

name: Marina Lounge

name: Mars Bar & Restaurant
note: SFGate reports the business is listed for sale, not closed.

facts.text: John Caine opened the bar in 1994; David Kiely and Keith Cochrane took over in the early 2000s.

Opened September 4, 2025 as Mary's on Haight in the space of the former queer bar Trax.
